indispensable.en: Clean water is indispensable for the survival of every living organism.
indispensable.zh: 清洁的水对每一个生物体的生存都必不可少。

indispensable.en: The lecture material proved indispensable for preparing her doctoral dissertation.
indispensable.zh: 事实证明，这些讲座材料对她准备博士论文必不可少。

indispensable.en: Effective communication remains an indispensable skill in every professional field.
indispensable.zh: 有效的沟通在每个职业领域都是一项不可或缺的技能。

merely.en: The committee rejected the proposal merely because it arrived after the deadline.
merely.zh: 委员会拒绝该提案，仅仅是因为它在截止日期之后才送达。

merely.en: He did not merely report the figures but also explained their significance in detail.
merely.zh: 他不仅仅报告了这些数字，还详细解释了它们的含义。

merely.en: Such a small sample size is merely suggestive and cannot support firm conclusions.
merely.zh: 如此小的样本量只是提示性的，无法支持确凿的结论。

barely.en: She barely had time to finish the abstract before the deadline arrived.
barely.zh: 在截止日期到来之前，她几乎没有时间完成摘要。

barely.en: The novel's central argument is barely intelligible to first-year undergraduates.
barely.zh: 这部小说的核心论点对一年级本科生来说几乎难以理解。

barely.en: Barely half of the participants reported regular physical activity during the survey.
barely.zh: 调查中只有不到一半的参与者报告经常进行体育活动。

representative.en: This specimen is a representative example of the region's volcanic rock.
representative.zh: 这个标本是该地区火山岩的代表性例子。

representative.en: Her career illustrates the representative obstacles faced by women in science.
representative.zh: 她的职业生涯展现了女性在科学领域面临的典型障碍。

representative.en: Each interviewee was asked to nominate a figure representative of their own generation.
representative.zh: 每位受访者被要求推荐一位能代表自己一代的人物。

accommodate.en: The new conference hall can accommodate up to eight hundred delegates.
accommodate.zh: 新的会议大厅最多可以容纳 800 名代表。

accommodate.en: The university renovated several dormitories to accommodate an increasing number of students.
accommodate.zh: 学校翻新了几栋宿舍楼，以容纳越来越多的学生。

accommodate.en: This flexible schedule should easily accommodate everyone's different working hours.
accommodate.zh: 这个灵活的日程安排应该能轻松适应每个人不同的工作时间。

twofold.en: The reform achieved a twofold increase in enrollment within three years.
twofold.zh: 这项改革在三年内使入学人数翻了一番。

twofold.en: The new method serves a twofold purpose: reducing costs and improving accuracy.
twofold.zh: 这种新方法有双重目的：降低成本并提高准确性。

twofold.en: The authors acknowledge a twofold limitation of the present study.
twofold.zh: 作者们承认当前研究存在两方面的局限。

feasible.en: Engineers concluded that the proposed expansion was technically feasible within two years.
feasible.zh: 工程师们得出结论，所提出的扩建方案在技术上是可行的，且可在两年内完成。

feasible.en: Given the available funding, a large-scale survey may not be feasible.
feasible.zh: 鉴于可用的资金，大规模调查可能并不可行。

feasible.en: The committee will consider any feasible alternative to the original design.
feasible.zh: 委员会将考虑原设计的任何可行替代方案。

intricate.en: The intricate network of tunnels beneath the temple required months of careful mapping.
intricate.zh: 寺庙下方错综复杂的隧道网络需要数月细致的测绘。

intricate.en: She explained the intricate relationship between temperature and reaction rate clearly.
intricate.zh: 她清楚地解释了温度与反应速率之间错综复杂的关系。

intricate.en: Solving the intricate scheduling problem required a more efficient algorithm.
intricate.zh: 解决这个复杂的调度问题需要一种更高效的算法。

interval.en: Measurements were recorded at regular intervals throughout the experiment.
interval.zh: 在整个实验过程中按固定间隔记录了测量数据。

interval.en: There was a long interval between the two published versions of the paper.
interval.zh: 该论文的两个已出版版本之间存在很长的时间间隔。

interval.en: Participants returned for testing at a twelve-week interval.
interval.zh: 参与者每 12 周返回进行一次测试。

preferable.en: Submitting the application online is preferable to delivering it by post.
preferable.zh: 在线提交申请比邮寄递交更可取。

preferable.en: For long documents, a printed copy is arguably preferable to a screen.
preferable.zh: 对于长篇文档来说，纸质版可以说比在屏幕上阅读更可取。

preferable.en: The panel considered a smaller sample preferable to a poorly controlled trial.
preferable.zh: 评审组认为较小的样本比控制不佳的试验更为可取。

hierarchical.en: The organization operates a hierarchical structure with clear lines of authority.
hierarchical.zh: 该组织实行等级分明的结构，权力关系清晰。

hierarchical.en: Hierarchical databases make it easier to locate related records efficiently.
hierarchical.zh: 层次化数据库使相关记录更容易被高效地检索。

hierarchical.en: Many universities still operate through a largely hierarchical system of decision-making.
hierarchical.zh: 许多大学的决策体系在很大程度上仍是等级化的。

fine-grained.en: Fine-grained analysis revealed subtle differences between the two prototypes.
fine-grained.zh: 细粒度的分析揭示了两个原型之间的细微差异。

fine-grained.en: The model employs fine-grained control to reproduce human speech patterns.
fine-grained.zh: 该模型采用精细的控制方式来重现人类的语音模式。

fine-grained.en: Access permissions are managed through fine-grained security rules in the database.
fine-grained.zh: 访问权限通过数据库中精细的安全规则进行管理。

legitimate.en: The court ruled that the search had been conducted without legitimate authority.
legitimate.zh: 法院裁定此次搜查是在没有合法授权的情况下进行的。

legitimate.en: Researchers must protect personal data collected for legitimate purposes.
legitimate.zh: 研究人员必须保护出于正当目的而收集的个人数据。

legitimate.en: Raising concerns about safety is a legitimate part of the consultation process.
legitimate.zh: 提出安全方面的担忧是协商程序中正当的一部分。

restrict.en: The regulation restricts access to sensitive personal records.
restrict.zh: 该规定限制了敏感个人记录的访问权限。

restrict.en: Narrow passageways restrict the movement of large equipment through the building.
restrict.zh: 狭窄的通道限制了大件设备在楼内的搬运。

restrict.en: She restricted her review to papers published after 2015.
restrict.zh: 她把综述范围限定在 2015 年之后发表的论文。

immerse.en: Graduate students immerse themselves in the literature before designing their experiments.
immerse.zh: 研究生们在设计实验之前会沉浸于相关文献之中。

immerse.en: He immersed himself in the local culture during his year abroad.
immerse.zh: 他在国外的那一年里完全沉浸于当地文化之中。

immerse.en: The program immerses new teachers in classroom practice from the first week.
immerse.zh: 该项目从第一周起就让新教师沉浸在课堂教学实践中。

plethora.en: The library holds a plethora of rare manuscripts on medieval trade.
plethora.zh: 图书馆收藏了大量关于中世纪贸易的珍贵手稿。

plethora.en: The journal published a plethora of studies on the topic last year.
plethora.zh: 该期刊去年发表了大量关于这一主题的研究。

plethora.en: The plethora of conflicting guidelines did more to confuse new reviewers than to help them.
plethora.zh: 过多而相互矛盾的指南与其说帮助了新评审员，不如说让他们更加困惑。

concomitant.en: The reform brought concomitant improvements in staff training and research funding.
concomitant.zh: 这项改革同时带来了员工培训和科研经费方面的改善。

concomitant.en: Rapid urban growth carried with it concomitant problems in waste management.
concomitant.zh: 快速的城市增长伴随着废物管理方面的种种问题。

concomitant.en: Every hypothesis is recorded together with its concomitant experimental conditions.
concomitant.zh: 每一个假设都与同时出现的实验条件一并记录在案。

necessarily.en: The two models are not necessarily in conflict with each other.
necessarily.zh: 这两个模型并不一定彼此矛盾。

necessarily.en: A larger sample size does not necessarily produce a more reliable result.
necessarily.zh: 更大的样本量并不一定能产生更可靠的结果。

necessarily.en: Increased funding does not necessarily improve the quality of teaching.
necessarily.zh: 增加经费并不一定能提高教学质量。

striking.en: The most striking feature of the painting is its unusual depth of color.
striking.zh: 这幅画最引人注目的特点是其非凡的色彩深度。

striking.en: There was a striking contrast between the two versions of the manuscript.
striking.zh: 手稿的两个版本之间存在显著的对比。

striking.en: Her striking decision to withdraw the paper struck the reviewers as remarkably bold.
striking.zh: 她撤下论文这一引人注目的决定让审稿人觉得格外大胆。

in situ.en: The fossils were examined in situ before any samples were removed.
in situ.zh: 在取下任何样本之前，这些化石都进行了原地检验。

in situ.en: Researchers left the sensors in situ to record changes over several months.
in situ.zh: 研究人员把传感器留在原地，以记录数月内的变化。

in situ.en: In situ conservation protects the mural without moving it from the wall.
in situ.zh: 原址保护在不将壁画从墙上移走的情况下对其加以保护。

pedagogical.en: The textbook was rewritten with pedagogical rather than purely archival purposes.
pedagogical.zh: 这本教材是出于教学目的而非纯粹的文献目的而重写的。

pedagogical.en: Teachers reported that the interactive exercises had clear pedagogical value.
pedagogical.zh: 教师们反映这些互动练习具有明确的教学价值。

pedagogical.en: Her lecture notes are praised for their clear pedagogical structure.
pedagogical.zh: 她的讲义因清晰的教学结构而受到称赞。

hallmark.en: Careful sourcing is a hallmark of serious academic writing.
hallmark.zh: 严谨的资料来源是严肃学术写作的显著特征。

hallmark.en: The building's stone arches are the hallmark of local architecture.
hallmark.zh: 这座建筑的石拱是当地建筑风格的标志。

hallmark.en: Rigorous peer review is a hallmark of quality in this journal.
hallmark.zh: 严格的同行评审是该期刊质量的一个标志。

well-defined.en: The study population must be described as a well-defined group of participants.
well-defined.zh: 研究对象必须被描述为一个界限清晰的参与者群体。

well-defined.en: Each category in the framework has a well-defined meaning and scope.
well-defined.zh: 该框架中的每个类别都有明确的含义和适用范围。

well-defined.en: A well-defined contract reduces disputes between the two departments.
well-defined.zh: 明确的合同条款减少了两部门之间的争议。

suspicious.en: The auditors grew suspicious when the totals did not match the receipts.
suspicious.zh: 当总数与收据不符时，审计人员起了疑心。

suspicious.en: Police described the package as suspicious but released it after inspection.
suspicious.zh: 警方称该包裹可疑，但检查后仍予以放行。

suspicious.en: Several researchers were suspicious of the claim's unusually favorable results.
suspicious.zh: 几位研究者对该说法异常有利的结果表示怀疑。

blurred.en: The boundary between research and commercial development has become increasingly blurred.
blurred.zh: 研究与商业开发之间的界线已变得越来越模糊。

blurred.en: Poor focus left the photographs blurred and difficult to interpret.
blurred.zh: 对焦不佳使照片模糊不清，难以解读。

blurred.en: The blurred lines of responsibility led to confusion during the emergency.
blurred.zh: 职责界限模糊导致应急期间出现了混乱。

prominent.en: She played a prominent role in establishing the national research center.
prominent.zh: 她在建立国家研究中心的过程中发挥了重要作用。

prominent.en: Economic inequality remains a prominent issue in contemporary public debate.
prominent.zh: 经济不平等仍然是当代公共辩论中的突出问题。

prominent.en: The building occupies a prominent position at the entrance to the campus.
prominent.zh: 这座建筑位于校园入口处十分显眼的位置。

notably.en: The study confirmed earlier findings, notably concerning adolescent sleep patterns.
notably.zh: 该研究证实了此前的发现，尤其是关于青少年睡眠模式的部分。

notably.en: Regional differences were small, notably in the northern provinces.
notably.zh: 地区差异很小，北部各省尤其如此。

notably.en: Notably, the effect persisted even after the software was updated.
notably.zh: 值得注意的是，即使软件更新后这一影响仍然持续存在。

compatible.en: The two measurement systems are entirely compatible with one another.
compatible.zh: 这两套测量系统彼此完全兼容。

compatible.en: Remote work and existing office arrangements remain largely compatible today.
compatible.zh: 远程办公与现有的办公安排在目前基本可以共存。

compatible.en: Vegetarian diets can be compatible with a balanced nutritional plan.
compatible.zh: 素食饮食可以与均衡的营养计划相协调。

retain.en: The company hopes to retain most of its experienced staff after the merger.
retain.zh: 公司希望在合并后保留大多数有经验的员工。

retain.en: These plants retain moisture in their roots throughout the dry season.
retain.zh: 这些植物在整个旱季将水分保留在根部。

retain.en: Participants were asked to retain their original survey answers for verification.
retain.zh: 参与者被要求保留其原始问卷答案以供核查。

invoke.en: The speaker invoked an ancient tradition to justify the new policy.
invoke.zh: 演讲者援引了一项古老传统来为新政策辩护。

invoke.en: The photographs invoke memories of childhood summers in the countryside.
invoke.zh: 这些照片唤起了人们对童年乡村夏日的回忆。

invoke.en: Critics invoke constitutional arguments against the proposed restrictions.
invoke.zh: 批评者援引宪法论据来反对拟议中的限制措施。

paradigm.en: The case became a paradigm for successful experimental design.
paradigm.zh: 该案例成为成功实验设计的范例。

paradigm.en: The discovery caused a paradigm shift within the entire field.
paradigm.zh: 这一发现促成了整个领域的范式转变。

paradigm.en: Students analyzed several paradigm examples in the introductory seminar.
paradigm.zh: 学生们在入门研讨课上分析了几个典型范例。

concurrent.en: The two laboratories operate concurrent trials on different patient groups.
concurrent.zh: 两间实验室针对不同患者群体同时进行试验。

concurrent.en: Concurrent access to the database requires a secure password system.
concurrent.zh: 并发访问该数据库需要一套安全的密码系统。

concurrent.en: The program's success rests on concurrent investment in teaching and research.
concurrent.zh: 该项目的成功依赖于对教学与研究的同步投入。

manifest.en: The early symptoms of the disease manifest as fatigue and blurred vision.
manifest.zh: 该病的早期症状表现为疲劳和视力模糊。

manifest.en: The reforms manifest themselves in higher participation from rural students.
manifest.zh: 这些改革体现在农村学生参与度的提高上。

manifest.en: Stress often manifests in the workplace as reduced productivity.
manifest.zh: 压力在工作场所中往往表现为生产力下降。
